description:
A string representing an IRI reference as defined by RFC 3987.

## Definition

`https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-data-types/def/data-type/string-iri-reference` is a `dt:DataType` in the `dt:dataTypes` concept system. It names a kind of data, not its encoding.

## Usage

An Implementation Profile can express this type as:

```json
{ "type": "string", "format": "iri-reference" }
```

Valid values: `../données/a.json`, `#section`.

May be relative; the internationalized counterpart of String — URI reference.

As with any JSON Schema `format`, whether a value is actually checked depends on the validator.
